# ENV007: Docker client and daemon API incompatibility

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: docker. Severity: warning.

Collector prerequisites: docker.

The advertised Docker API ranges or explicit API override cannot overlap the daemon's supported range.

Evidence required: Valid advertised API bounds proving disjoint ranges, or an explicit API override outside the daemon range.

Manual steps:

- Remove an unsupported Docker API override or choose a client supported by the local daemon.

Verify with `envdoctor diagnose --rule ENV007`.

Limitations:

- Different Docker product versions alone do not establish incompatibility; newer clients can negotiate down.
- Missing/malformed API bounds remain unknown. API policy and sources are recorded in ADR 0005.
- Selected remote contexts are never contacted; ENV017 remains later scope.

No command is executed by this rule. Evidence comes only from the snapshot. Failed prerequisite collectors disable the rule. Positive, negative and edge fixtures cover Windows, Linux and macOS; platform exclusions are listed above.

Documentation: <https://github.com/shellghostt/envdoctor/blob/main/docs/rules/ENV007.md>.
